literal: Yet by nature he was dangerous and jealous; in feeling and duty he was not steadfast. Outwardly he seemed square and rule-bound; inwardly he was in fact unstable.
idiomatic: Yet by nature he was dangerous and jealous, and shallow in feeling and duty. Outwardly he seemed square and rule-bound; inwardly he was unstable.

literal: He accepted bribes and twisted the law in written judgments; secretly he was harsh and cruel, and harmed many. Gentlemen and commoners alike feared and hated him.
idiomatic: He took bribes and twisted the law; secretly he was harsh and cruel and harmed many. Gentlemen and commoners alike feared and hated him.

literal: Zhang, a concubine of Wei Prince of Dongping Yuan Kuang, was dissolute and unrestrained. Chu at first had an illicit affair with her, then took her in as his wife.
idiomatic: Zhang, a concubine of Wei Prince of Dongping Yuan Kuang, was dissolute and unrestrained. Chu at first had an affair with her, then took her as his wife.

literal: Beguiled by her slander, he drove off his former wife, the Yu clan, and would not acknowledge his son. Resentment filled the household; one after another they reported him to the authorities. He was deeply scorned by the age.
idiomatic: Beguiled by her slander, he drove off his former wife of the Yu clan and would not acknowledge his son. The household seethed with resentment and members denounced one another to the authorities. The world held him in deep contempt.

literal: Posthumously he was given Qing Province inspector.
idiomatic: Posthumously he was made inspector of Qing Province.

literal: Jing Xianjun, styled Xiaoying, was a native of Pingyang.
idiomatic: Jing Xianjun, styled Xiaoying, was a native of Pingyang.

literal: In youth he was heroic and chivalrous and had integrity; he formed ties with bold fellows.
idiomatic: In youth he was heroic and chivalrous and kept his integrity; he formed ties with bold fellows.

literal: He was made commandant of the forest guard.
idiomatic: He was made commandant of the forest guard.

literal: When Gao Huan took up Jin Province, Xianjun took the occasion to pay his respects. Gao Huan spoke with him and was pleased, then recommended him as vice governor.
idiomatic: When Gao Huan took up Jin Province, Xianjun used the occasion to pay his respects. Gao Huan spoke with him and was pleased, then had him appointed vice governor.

literal: When the righteous rising was launched, Xianjun was made mobile headquarters clerk in the supplies bureau.
idiomatic: When the righteous rising was launched, he was made mobile headquarters clerk in the supplies bureau.

literal: Following the attack on Ye, he ordered Xianjun to supervise construction of the earthen ramp.
idiomatic: On the attack on Ye he had Xianjun supervise construction of the earthen ramp.

literal: When the city was taken, he again followed in pacifying the western barbarians.
idiomatic: When the city fell he again followed in pacifying the western barbarians.

literal: He was transferred to director of the imperial punishments bureau and, with the generals on campaign, repeatedly had merit.
idiomatic: He was transferred to director of the imperial punishments bureau and, campaigning with the generals, won repeated merit.

literal: He again followed Gao Huan in pacifying rebellion and defeated Yuwen Tai.
idiomatic: He again followed Gao Huan in pacifying rebellion and defeated Yuwen Tai.

literal: He defeated Hou Jing, pacified Shouchun, and settled Huainan.
idiomatic: He defeated Hou Jing, pacified Shouchun, and settled Huainan.

literal: He also seized territory at Sanjiang Ford and built many garrison towns.
idiomatic: He also seized territory at Sanjiang Ford and built many garrison towns.

literal: In succession he was made Yan Province inspector and died.
idiomatic: In succession he was made inspector of Yan Province and died.

literal: Ping Jian, styled Mingda, was a native of Ji in Yan Commandery.
idiomatic: Ping Jian, styled Mingda, was a native of Ji in Yan Commandery.

literal: His father Sheng was An Province inspector.
idiomatic: His father Sheng was inspector of An Province.

literal: Jian from youth was clever and keen, and had considerable resolve and strength.
idiomatic: From youth Jian was clever and keen, with considerable resolve and strength.

literal: He received learning from Xu Zunming and did not pursue glosses on the text. Though he honored Confucian studies, he had a bold, chivalrous air.
idiomatic: He studied under Xu Zunming and did not pursue glosses on the text. Though he honored Confucian learning, he had a bold, chivalrous air.

literal: Late in Xiaochang, bandits rose everywhere. Seeing that the realm would soon fall into disorder, he went to Luoyang and made friends with Murong Yan in the trade of hiring out horses.
idiomatic: Late in Xiaochang bandits rose everywhere. Seeing that the realm would soon fall into disorder, he went to Luoyang and befriended Murong Yan in the trade of hiring out horses.

literal: Jian was skillful by nature; at night he painted for foreigners to supply food and clothing.
idiomatic: Jian was skillful by nature; at night he painted for foreign patrons to pay for food and clothing.

literal: He told his kinsmen, "Fortune has its stain and its rise; when disorder reaches the extreme, order comes.
idiomatic: He told his kinsmen, "Fortune has its stain and its rise; when disorder reaches the extreme, order comes.

literal: Bing Province is land of warhorses. Erzhu is the hero born for the age; he raises the banner of righteousness and marches under the charge to punish wrongdoing, toiling in loyalty and straining every force — now is the time."
idiomatic: Bing Province is land of warhorses. Erzhu is the hero born for the age; he raises the banner of righteousness and marches under the charge to punish wrongdoing, toiling in loyalty and straining every force — now is the time."

literal: Thereupon they went together to Erzhu Rong at Jinyang and set forth a plan to still disorder and settle the people.
idiomatic: Thereupon they went together to Erzhu Rong at Jinyang and set forth a plan to still disorder and settle the people.

literal: Rong was greatly struck by him and at once appointed him staff officer of the vanguard. Following the pacification of Gong and Mi, in every battle he was first to charge.
idiomatic: Rong was greatly struck by him and at once appointed him staff officer of the vanguard. Following the pacification of Gong and Mi, in every battle he was first to charge.

literal: He was made general who pacifies the army and inspector of Xiang Province.
idiomatic: He was made general who pacifies the army and inspector of Xiang Province.

literal: When Gao Huan raised the righteous standard at Xindu, Jian came over to him of his own accord.
idiomatic: When Gao Huan raised the righteous standard at Xindu, Jian came over to him of his own accord.

literal: Gao Huan said to Jian, "In days past the imperial net slackened at the center, yet you had already early exhausted your loyalty.
idiomatic: Gao Huan said to Jian, "In days past the imperial net slackened at the center, yet you had already early spent your loyalty.

literal: Now that Erzhu runs riot, you can again leave rebellion and follow what is right.
idiomatic: Now that Erzhu runs riot, you can again leave rebellion and follow what is right.

literal: When the branches fall, one knows the pine and bamboo."
idiomatic: When the branches fall, one knows the pine and bamboo."

literal: He at once recommended him and appointed him western campaign general.
idiomatic: He at once recommended him and appointed him western campaign general.

literal: Inspector of Huai Province.
idiomatic: Inspector of Huai Province.

literal: Jian memorialized asking to build a city on the old Zhi Road west of the province to block and hold back western raiders; the court approved.
idiomatic: Jian memorialized asking to build a city on the old Zhi Road west of the province to block western raiders; the court approved.

literal: Before long Western Wei came to attack.
idiomatic: Before long Western Wei came to attack.

literal: At that time the newly built city had not yet gathered grain and arms; it had long lacked water, and the troops were greatly afraid.
idiomatic: At that time the newly built city had not yet gathered grain and arms; it had long lacked water, and the troops were greatly afraid.

literal: Inside the south gate was a well; as soon as one drew from it, it ran dry.
idiomatic: Inside the south gate was a well; as soon as one drew from it, it ran dry.

literal: Jian then put on full dress and cap, bowed over the well and prayed; by dawn a spring welled up in the well, and the whole city drew from it.
idiomatic: Jian then put on full dress and cap, bowed over the well and prayed; by dawn a spring welled up in the well, and the whole city drew from it.

literal: The Wei army was defeated and withdrew; for his merit he was promoted to opening office, equal in insignia to three masters of ceremonies.
idiomatic: The Wei army was defeated and withdrew; for his merit he was promoted to opening office, equal in insignia to three masters of ceremonies.

literal: At that time He Shikai, through fawning favor, had power that tilted the court ranks. He sent someone to ask for Jian's beloved concubine, Lady Liu; Jian at once sent her.
idiomatic: At that time He Shikai, through fawning favor, had power that tilted the court ranks. He sent someone to ask for Jian's beloved concubine, Lady Liu; Jian at once sent her.

literal: He then told others, "When this old man loses A-Liu, what difference from death?
idiomatic: He then told others, "When this old man loses A-Liu, what difference from death?

literal: One must after all make plans for oneself — it could not be otherwise."
idiomatic: One must after all make plans for oneself — it could not be otherwise."

literal: Because of this he was made Qi Province inspector.
idiomatic: Because of this he was made inspector of Qi Province.

literal: Jian governed eight provinces in all and twice held Huai Province; wherever he served, officials missed him, and steles were raised to praise his virtue.
idiomatic: Jian governed eight provinces in all and twice held Huai Province; wherever he served, officials missed him, and steles were raised to praise his virtue.

literal: He entered court as director of the masters of writing in the imperial punishments bureau.
idiomatic: He entered court as director of the masters of writing in the imperial punishments bureau.

literal: The full text has been collated against the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi, November 1972.
idiomatic: The full text has been collated against the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi, November 1972.
